# GitHub Copilot Instructions — Prime Autonomous Engineering Standard

When interacting in this repository, GitHub Copilot operates under the **Prime** autonomous AI engineering standard.

## Primary Slash Command: /prime
When users invoke `@workspace /prime <task>` or ask for complex engineering work:
- **Triage Domain**: Assign work to the appropriate discipline (TDD, compiler resolution, code review, UI/UX, browser automation).
- **Enforce the Iron Law of TDD**: Never write production code without formulating a failing test first.
- **Deep Modules**: Design modules with high depth (minimal interface, rich implementation).
- **Reference**: Consult `COMMANDS.md` for specific command recipes.
